Refactor complete.

- The species registry now owns creation, probabilities, colors, and labels in [`AnimalType.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/AnimalType.java) and [`PlantType.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/PlantType.java).
- [`PopulationGenerator.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/PopulationGenerator.java) now drives population setup directly from those enums, instead of going through a deleted factory layer.
- I removed the redundant factory classes and the unused producer path from [`Simulator.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/Simulator.java).
- Stats and labels now use human-readable names from the registry in [`FieldStats.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/FieldStats.java), [`Counter.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/Counter.java), and [`SimulatorView.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/SimulatorView.java).
